differences: Text B says 'This spell does nothing', omitting the library search, put-into-hand and shuffle that Text A's spell does.

Text B gives the alternative cost and timing as 'only during your turn, during the declare blockers step' and then 'any time you could cast an instant', which allows casting at any time an instant could be cast; Text A allows the alternative cost only during the declare blockers step of combat.

Text B does not require returning an unblocked attacker in the same way: it says 'returning an unblocked attacker to its owner's hand rather than paying its mana cost' without the reminder's 'also' framing, which is a different cost structure from the reminder.
